knowledge.title: Mobile mail stops syncing after a password change
knowledge.text: Remove the mail account from the phone and add it again with the new password.

knowledge.title: VPN drops at the branch office: check the MTU on the concentrator
knowledge.text: Symptom: VPN tunnels of the branch office drop and come back on their own; large transfers fail first. Cause: packets over 1400 bytes are fragmented between the branch and its concentrator, vpn-branch-01. Fix: set the MTU to 1400 on the concentrator. A firmware upgrade resets it to 1500: check it after each upgrade.

knowledge.title: ERP reports are slow at month end
knowledge.text: Month-end batch jobs load erp-db. Run reports outside 08:00-10:00.

incidents.close_notes: MTU lowered to 1400 on the branch concentrator (KB0020002).
